name: Executive Calendar & Web Intelligence
description: Fetches daily meetings from Calendar MCP, runs parallel web searches on attendees and companies, detects schedule conflicts, and generates an executive intelligence briefing.

date.description: Date or time range to inspect (e.g. 'today')

channel.description: Delivery channel for the executive briefing

nodes.prompt:
Inspect today's calendar events fetched via Calendar MCP:
{{nodes.fetch_calendar.output}}

Identify all meeting participants, client companies, and agenda topics. Use searchWeb to research:
1. Recent company news and product launches for the organizations involved.
2. Professional backgrounds and key projects for external attendees.
3. 3 strategic talking points for each meeting.
Return a structured attendee intelligence briefing.

Audit today's calendar events:
{{nodes.fetch_calendar.output}}

Perform a schedule health check:
1. Detect overlapping or double-booked meetings.
2. Flag back-to-back blocks without at least 15 minutes of recovery/prep time.
3. Score today's schedule intensity from 1 to 10 and recommend optimal focus blocks.
Return a schedule audit report.

Synthesize a Morning Executive Briefing Dossier combining calendar schedule, attendee intelligence, and conflict warnings:
{{nodes.dossier_collector.output}}

Create a publication-ready briefing:
# 🌅 Executive Morning Intelligence Dossier
## 📅 Chronological Agenda & Priority Tiers
## 👥 Meeting Intelligence & Attendee Talking Points
## ⚠️ Schedule Health Warnings & Action Items

Use writeFile to save this briefing to 'scratch/executive_briefing.md'. Return the full formatted Markdown briefing.

nodes.message: Executive briefing prepared for {{inputs.date}}. Approve dispatch to {{inputs.channel}}?
